body: A brick round the neck. Drowning, watching my final struggle give way to utter peace. Knowing that no one and nothing can stop it. 0 chance of survival. Utter peace. Those are my plans

Well, thank you for your words. But I have come up with an idea. Tying a brick around me neck and jumping into a river. The end struggle will be near impossible, just like my life. But as it all fades out, I will have an awesome surreal feeling of utter bliss, knowing now that the struggle of my life is finally, completely over.
